meta.description: A fictional two-day sample trip that shows every component of the travel coffee-table kit.

masthead.kicker: Travel coffee-table kit · a fictional sample
masthead.title: Example Bay & the Lantern Coast
masthead.lede: Two unhurried days of harbour light, a lighthouse, sea cliffs and a Sunday market. Every place here is invented.
masthead.edition: Kit sample · every name, number and link is invented · all times local

overview.title: One base. Two gentle days.
overview.intro: One night at Hotel Tidewater, arriving and leaving by train. **Nothing is booked.**

days.title: Arrive by the sea
days.sub: A gentle first day: the quay, the lighthouse and a long lunch.

stops.role: Short visit; the climb is optional.

Indoor tasting rooms, five minutes from the hotel.

plan_c.role: Cool stone rooms in heat; sheltered from wind.

plan_notes.b: Everything stays within ten minutes of the hotel, under cover [[src:ex_tourism]].
plan_notes.c: Keep the morning short and be indoors by 11am.

tldr: One night at **Hotel Tidewater**, arriving and leaving by the coast line.
Day 1: the harbour steps, the lighthouse and Lantern Beach; Day 2: the Ochre Cliffs and the Sunday market.
Rain has Plan B under glass; heat or wind has Plan C in cool stone rooms [[src:ex_tourism]].
